signature.name: VTask.lift
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> [CommRing R] -> (I : Ideal R) -> {M : Type u_4} -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [Module R M] -> {N : Type u_5} -> [AddCommGroup N] -> [Module R N] -> (f : (n : ℕ) → M →ₗ[R] N ⧸ I ^ n • ⊤) -> (h : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n), AdicCompletion.transitionMap I N hle ∘ₗ f n = f m) -> M →ₗ[R] AdicCompletion I N

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.lift is a total construction with no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for every ideal I, every module M and N, and every coherent family f satisfying the compatibility hypothesis h.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : ∀ n : ℕ, M →ₗ[R] N ⧸ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R N)) (h : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n), AdicCompletion.transitionMap I N hle ∘ₗ f n = f m) (x y : M), VTask.lift I f h (x + y) = VTask.lift I f h x + VTask.lift I f h y

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : ∀ n : ℕ, M →ₗ[R] N ⧸ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R N)) (h : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n), AdicCompletion.transitionMap I N hle ∘ₗ f n = f m) (r : R) (x : M), VTask.lift I f h (r • x) = r • VTask.lift I f h x

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : ∀ n : ℕ, M →ₗ[R] N ⧸ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R N)) (h : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n), AdicCompletion.transitionMap I N hle ∘ₗ f n = f m) (x : M), VTask.lift I f h 0 = 0

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : ∀ n : ℕ, M →ₗ[R] N ⧸ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R N)) (h : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n), AdicCompletion.transitionMap I N hle ∘ₗ f n = f m) (g : M →ₗ[R] AdicCompletion I N), (∀ n, AdicCompletion.eval I N n ∘ₗ g = f n) → g = VTask.lift I f h
